content_html:
Choosing the right footwear for Machu Picchu is not a minor detail.

It can be the difference between enjoying the hike… or suffering through every step.

Why is it important to wear good shoes at Machu Picchu?

Machu Picchu is not just a tourist visit.

It involves walking on:

  • Uneven stone paths
  • Constant uphill and downhill sections
  • Wet and slippery areas

Poor footwear increases the risk of falls, blisters, and injuries.

Best type of footwear for Machu Picchu

1. Trekking boots (recommended)

  • Better ankle support
  • Soles with strong grip
  • Ideal for rain and uneven terrain

2. Hiking shoes / trekking sneakers (lightweight option)

  • More comfortable and lighter
  • Good traction if high quality
  • Ideal during the dry season

What matters most is not the brand… it’s the functionality.

Common mistakes when choosing footwear

Avoid these frequent mistakes:

Wearing brand-new shoes on the same day
Using flat-soled sneakers (no traction)
Bringing sandals or open shoes
Choosing uncomfortable or stiff footwear

Result:

  • Blisters
  • Foot pain
  • Higher risk of slipping

What footwear to wear depending on the season

Dry season (April – October):

  • Hiking shoes or light trekking boots

Rainy season (November – March):

  • Waterproof boots with strong grip

During the rainy season, the terrain can become very slippery.

Extra tip many travelers forget

Wear proper socks:

  • Breathable
  • Quick-drying
  • Without thick seams

A good pair of socks can prevent blisters.

Avoid accidents during your visit

Many travelers underestimate the terrain.

But the reality is:

  • There are steep areas
  • Wet stone stairs
  • Narrow paths

Good footwear is not a luxury… it’s safety.

Enjoy Machu Picchu without worries

The right footwear allows you to:

  • Walk with stability
  • Avoid injuries
  • Have more energy
  • Enjoy the experience to the fullest
